analysis:
Both units are base-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (base lines 458-656 and 657-850). No patch hunks and no head-side text were supplied, so the actual PR change to the file is not visible and cannot be assessed. The excerpts contain only historical release notes, not executable code.

Security-relevant claims in the excerpt that may relate to a later changelog edit:
- SSD prefix cache (T-041): TTL raised 15 to 30 minutes, recorded as the SEC-035 re-acceptance; write budget raised to 750 GB/day; MiMo COMPLETE-prefix caching default-on, with DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0 as the kill switch.
- App Attest rotation and key recovery (T-053, T-057).
- The unauthenticated earnings lookup, which the base text says was removed (T-031).
- Attestation challenges now fail closed.
- Protocol 1 and 2 shadow frames removed.

The PR may change any of these claims. A later pass should check three things when the patch is available: that changelog statements stay consistent with the threat model, especially the 30-minute TTL cap and the SEC-035 sign-off; that the entries do not overclaim security guarantees; and that the cache or TTL defaults claimed there match the code. No cross-file interactions can be derived from CHANGELOG.md alone.
